title: Tegnap: The Same Day, Retold in the Past

sections.title: Units 24-25 doing the same job
sections.content: Tell the same story about yesterday, and every verb just needs its past-tense form — regular verbs with -t/-ott/-ett/-ött, plus the irregulars you already know: mentem, jöttem, voltam, ettem, ittam. The connectors from Unit 1 (előbb, aztán, utána, végül) work exactly the same way with past-tense verbs as they do with present-tense ones.

items.spanish: Tegnap reggel hétkor felkeltem, gyorsan megreggeliztem, és nyolckor elindultam dolgozni.
items.english: Yesterday morning I got up at seven, had breakfast quickly, and set off for work at eight.

items.spanish: Egész nap sokat dolgoztam, és délben a kollégáimmal ebédeltem egy közeli étteremben.
items.english: I worked a lot all day, and at noon I had lunch with my colleagues at a nearby restaurant.

items.spanish: Munka után hazamentem, vacsoráztam Károllyal, és korán elaludtam.
items.english: After work I went home, had dinner with Károly, and fell asleep early.

sections.content: mentem, jöttem and voltam don't take the regular -t- past marker you'd expect — they're irregular — but előbb, aztán, utána and végül connect them exactly the same way they connect any regular past-tense verb.
